messages.context: Wireless operator Harold Cottam on RMS Carpathia received Titanic's distress call and immediately confirmed their rescue sprint at maximum boiler pressure.
messages.evidence_notes: Harold Cottam confirmed that after receiving Titanic's distress message, he transmitted 'Coming hard' to indicate maximum speed.

messages.context: Titanic began transmitting the Marconi distress call CQD following the collision, subsequently adding the new international signal SOS.
messages.evidence_notes: Wireless records document Titanic calling CQD and SOS following the order of Captain Smith.

messages.message: WE ARE STOPPED AND SURROUNDED BY ICE
messages.normalized_answer: WE ARE STOPPED AND SURROUNDED BY ICE
messages.context: SS Californian warned Titanic that their ship had come to a complete stop due to field ice directly ahead.
messages.evidence_notes: Operator Cyril Evans sent this warning directly to Titanic before being told to stand by as Titanic cleared commercial traffic.
